hashEncoding: sha256(JSON.stringify(value)); preserves key/array order and every recording field

policy.d6: Same runner only; P95 +10%, objective-round P99 / command max +25%, elapsed +10%, minimum 1ms. Any metric crossing in >=2 of 3 comparable rounds means regression. Full routes with different event/objective-block counts are report-only; the identical input prefix decides. Absolute times report only.
policy.correctness: hard: complete replay, zero OOS, exact semantic/RNG/domain/final state hashes
policy.work: hard: calls <= calibrated maximum; objective block count exact

relativeWarning.rule: dedicated runner: at least 2 of 3; currently report only

source.planner: original complete route reused; no world edits

provenance.calibration: First three complete B runs, rounds 1/2/3; no sample removal or new timing.
provenance.acceptance: Maintainer ruling 2026-10-16: B4-5 accepted under revised D6.
limitations: Offline checks reuse calibration runs; no independent fourth replay.
Absolute timings are report-only and specific to this cloud runner.
all complete routes have different workloads; A/B timing verdict uses identical 1714-command prefix, not a D20 comparison.
